articles.summary: RailPulse™ is a telematics platform that provides real-time visibility into railcar location, condition and performance. By delivering secure, standardized data, RailPulse™ helps railroads, shippers and fleet owners improve asset tracking, operational efficiency and supply chain coordination across the North American rail network.
articles.title: RailPulse™ Brings Real-Time Visibility to Customers
